translated_title: SEP to Consult More Than 1 Million Teachers on Cell Phones in Classrooms, Delgado Says
original_title: SEP consultará a más de 1 millón de maestros sobre celulares en las aulas: Delgado
author: Darren García
meta_description: Sixteen states already restrict phones in schools; the two-day vote precedes a nationwide push and three regional forums on social media's harm to minors.
